title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de entender o funcionamento da operação da empresa como um todo, desde o planejamento de capacidade até a tomada de decisão estratégica sobre alocações e demandas futuras.

  • Habilidade para estruturar, interpretar e analisar dados (Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário/avançado);

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, BioBlanks is an end-to-end sustainable manufacturing platform leveraging innovative practices to create custom apparel for modern businesses and creators. We spent the past 3 years building a proprietary process in downtown Los Angeles to create apparel that rivals your favorite luxury brand while ensuring that the garments are kind to the earth. We use traceable organic materials, low-impact dyes, and regenerative manufacturing methods to ensure our customers not only love our merch, but the earth does as well. And the best part? title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;

  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;

  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)


Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes.

title: ML/Data Science Lead
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Science Lead will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Lead will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 10 years in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:


Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, extract and analyze data from various platforms, and create actionable reports. You will play a key role in providing valuable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. Therefore, the ideal candidate should have a strong analytical mindset, excellent data manipulation skills, and a passion for transforming data into actionable business intelligence.


Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Experienced in SQL and advanced SQL queries, to extract and manipulate data.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and how to design effective data structures for reporting and analysis.


Skills and Strengths:


  • SQL Queries
  • MySQL
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • BI Analysis
  • Data Visualization & Reporting (Google Looker Preferred)
  • Business Presentations
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Python (a plus)


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Collect and extract data from SQL databases using advanced queries and data modeling.
  • Utilize data analysis techniques to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Develop reports to provide valuable insights to stakeholders that will support data-driven decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and identify business needs and document reporting requirements.
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools to anticipate future trends and outcomes, helping in strategic planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting by validating data integrity.
  • Maintain documentation of reports, queries, and data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data-related processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency, resolving data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
  • Stay updated with the latest BI trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating best practices into work, to improve reporting capabilities.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.


Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Analista de Cobrança TM Digital
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir os processos de análise de crédito, por meio da verificação documental e avaliação criteriosa das informações, emitindo parecer técnico com aprovação, reprovação ou encaminhamento para instâncias superiores, conforme alçada estabelecida.
  • Fornecer informações completas e estruturadas à equipe comercial, filiais e instâncias superiores, assegurando embasamento sólido para decisões de crédito e cobrança assertivas.
  • Participar ativamente das negociações com clientes e time comercial, respeitando as diretrizes da política da companhia em termos de prazos, juros e condições, além de propor estruturas diferenciadas e personalizadas visando resolver conflitos e aumentar a rentabilidade das operações.
  • Executar o acompanhamento físico e remoto das garantias vinculadas às operações de crédito, reportando avanços e desvios ao Supervisor Regional conforme os parâmetros definidos.
  • Manter agenda contínua de visitas técnicas aos clientes para fortalecer o relacionamento, monitorar a evolução dos negócios e avaliar riscos locais, com produção de relatórios específicos sobre clientes e contexto da filial.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e cobrança de clientes inadimplentes, conforme a régua definida pela Política de Crédito, além de manter relacionamento com tradings e armazéns terceiros responsáveis por produtos em garantia ou renegociados.
  • Consolidar e reportar ao Supervisor Regional os KPIs da filial conforme o cronograma definido pelo Gerente de Crédito, contribuindo para a gestão estratégica da área.
  • Realizar análise documental (CPRs, NPs, duplicatas, certidões, matrículas etc.), acompanhar a formalização das operações e monitorar a carteira para garantir o efetivo recebimento dos créditos.
  • Interagir com as áreas jurídica, comercial e de crédito e cobrança para desenvolver estratégias de mitigação de risco e soluções customizadas de crédito e cobrança, com foco na fidelização do cliente.
  • Acompanhar continuamente o lastro e os riscos vinculados às operações financeiras agrícolas, como CPRs e seguros, assegurando a integridade das garantias envolvidas.
  • Propor melhorias e desenvolver novas soluções de crédito e cobrança, contribuindo para o crescimento da companhia por meio da ampliação do portfólio e ações de cross-selling.
  • Atuar ativamente em comitês de crédito e cobrança, promovendo discussões técnicas e colaborativas com áreas internas e parceiros externos.



Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Ciências Econômicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análise de crédito e cobrança do agronegócio, especialmente operações de barter;
  • Experiência com execuções judiciais de garantias, especialmente arresto de penhor agrícola na safra;
  • Boa capacidade analítica, assertividade, planejamento e organização;
  • Boa comunicação (escrita e verbal) e habilidade em trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de visitas a clientes e reuniões periódicas presenciais.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation

Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).

  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

Interviews will be conducted in English


Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.

  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.


✨ O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.


As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.


Junior Recruitment Analyst - Hybrid (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)


This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.


Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature , process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.


What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.

  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil

Departamento: Vendas – APC, América Latina

Reporta a: Diretor de Vendas, América Latina


Propósito :

Impulsionar o crescimento comercial e técnico dos produtos da APC (plasma, hemácias e outros ingredientes do Grupo Lauridsen) nos mercados de suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura no Brasil, com foco na geração de demanda, no desenvolvimento de distribuidores, consultores e key accounts.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia de vendas

  • Liderar e executar o plano de vendas e negócios para a linha de produtos APC no Brasil, alinhado com as metas da APC em nível global.
  • Desenvolver e manter negócios com key accounts, incluindo cooperativas, premixeiras e fábricas de ração. Manter bom relacionamento com os clientes existentes e identificar um forte pipeline de oportunidades.
  • Selecionar / avaliar e nomear novos distribuidores para estados potenciais. Capacidade de gerenciar, motivar e treinar distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento técnico para promover ingredientes especiais e capacidade de demonstrar valor / retorno sobre investimento.
  • Conhecimento prático nas indústrias de Suínos, Aves e Aquicultura no mercado brasileiro. Liderar e impulsionar a ativação de novos negócios e manter bom relacionamento com tomadores de decisão-chave será uma vantagem adicional.
  • Formular estratégias comerciais para atingir as metas acordadas de vendas, margens e gestão de crédito para o Brasil.
  • Implementar o plano estratégico para expandir os negócios da APC no Brasil, incluindo gestão de canais.
  • Negociar preços e manter margens alinhadas aos objetivos regionais e globais.
  • Gestão de produto e planejamento estratégico.
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão (disponibilidade, demanda, capacidade).
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente os estoques das fábricas, garantindo eficiência e agilidade frente a diferentes cenários de demanda.
  • Demonstrar boa capacidade de escuta ativa, atendendo de forma eficaz clientes internos e externos.


Estratégia de marketing

  • Implementar o posicionamento adequado dos produtos e definir metas de desenvolvimento focadas para o Brasil.
  • Assegurar um bom entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, das condições de mercado e das atividades dos concorrentes para desenvolver estratégias de produto e de canais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com time regional e global para obter o suporte necessário.
  • Desenvolver um plano de marketing por meio de anúncios, feiras, seminários, eventos, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos:

Este cargo exige capacidades para aplicar habilidades de negócios e técnicas relacionadas às diferentes aplicações por espécie e ao uso dos produtos. Além disso, o ocupante da posição deve compreender as necessidades do mercado, identificar oportunidades e disseminar informações sobre os produtos, apoiando as áreas técnica e de marketing no desenvolvimento de planos/estratégias para o crescimento do negócio.


Condições de trabalho:

Esta posição exige que o ocupante viaje regularmente a trabalho. Além disso, o titular do cargo passa tempo nos seguintes ambientes: escritórios administrativos, conferências e escritórios de clientes. 

  • A vaga é destinada a cidadãos e residentes no Brasil.
  • Trabalho remoto com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (40–60% do tempo).
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo com bônus por desempenho.
  • Suporte regional e conexão com a estrutura técnica/comercial global.


Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou Agronomia, com conhecimento em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e paixão pela indústria de nutrição animal.
  • Cerca de 5 a 10 anos de experiência relevante em vendas e marketing na indústria B2B de nutrição animal.
  • Perfil comercial, postura prática e proativa, com boas habilidades de comunicação.
  • Sensibilidade multicultural e fluência em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas em suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura.


Sobre a APC

A APC é líder mundial na produção e comercialização de proteínas sanguíneas derivadas de plasma e hemácias. Nossa história começou em 1981, quando os cientistas da APC descobriram o poderoso papel que as proteínas funcionais derivadas do plasma desempenham em ajudar a apoiar e manter a função imunológica em animais. O negócio pioneiro focado em estudos científicos rendeu mais de 600 artigos publicados em revistas científicas internacionais e mais de uma dúzia de patentes relacionadas à coleta e processamento das proteínas do sangue e do plasma. Hoje, a APC emprega mais de 500 pessoas e opera 17 fábricas em oito países em todo o mundo. A APC continua comprometida com a essência de sua missão de ajudar animais a atingir o melhor desempenho por meio do uso de proteínas funcionais inovadoras que impactam positivamente a saúde animal.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer (Node.js / React / AdTech) – Contract (6+ Months, Extension Likely)

Location: Remote (EU Time Zones)

Contract Length: 6 months – strong potential for long-term extensions

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: Node.js, React, APIs, Social/YouTube integrations, AdTech, Creator/UGC discovery


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Engineer to help build a next-generation AdTech platform , supporting categories such as beauty, lifestyle, UGC, and topic-based recommendations for a Euro Retail and Marketing powerhouse.


This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.


This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.


Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences


API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale


AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams


Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD


Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact


Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)
  • Experience in AdTech, marketing tech, creator platforms, or discovery/recommendation systems
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or white-label solutions
  • Strong product mindset — comfortable owning features, making trade-offs, and shipping iteratively
  • Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear technical plans
  • Strong communication, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with video/content metadata (categories, beauty, topics, “lookalike” discovery)
  • Understanding of ranking, scoring, or classification models
  • Background with UGC/creator ecosystems (YouTube creators, UGC workflows, performance marketing)
  • Experience with event-driven microservices or data pipelines
  • GraphQL experience
  • Experience in high-scale consumer-facing platforms


Why This Role?

  • High-impact greenfield project
  • Central to the business’ advertising & creator strategy
  • Autonomy to shape the product and tech direction
  • Flexible remote contract with extensions very likely

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work

______________________________________________________________

  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

_______________________________________________________________


Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.
