title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience


Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) – Build a Global Mental Health Platform (US-Based)
description:
To our friends in Brazil: We are specifically recruiting here because the React/Next.js talent is world-class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge: Keep your day job, contribute 5-10 hours/week, and earn substantial equity in a US-based C-Corp.


This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.


Unacceptable. We're fixing it.


Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider-centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.


Next: an AI-powered booking and translation layer with real-time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system-level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.


The Opportunity: Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment: 5-10 hours/week, equity-only, alongside your primary role.


You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.


We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.


Who You Are (and how you show up)


  • Mission-obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.
  • Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.
  • Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.
  • Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.
  • Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low-ego reviews.
  • Efficiency and Output Driven: Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.


What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End-to-end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next:


  • Add recurring calendar availability
  • Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site
  • Roll out the Hotline
  • Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)
  • Add location-based navigation
  • Add site-wide translation and real-time audio translation
  • API/MCP integrations


Our stack: Next.js/React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI-assisted workflows (Cursor/Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.


The Deal: Transparent Equity Partnership


  • Merit-based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.
  • Points-for-outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.
  • All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.
  • Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.
  • Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6-month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3-year period.
  • Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.
  • High-impact bounties. Mission-critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.
  • Locked-in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.
  • No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.


Why This Will Define Your Career


  • Build Your US Track Record: This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.
  • USD-Denominated Upside: You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar-based asset ($100M+ target valuation).
  • Direct Access: You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.
  • Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.


Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.


This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.


To Apply: Send:

  • GitHub (or 1-2 PRs you're proud of) If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.
  • A short note: why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through


If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.

  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.

  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Analista de Sistemas – Angular, React e Next.js SR
description:
Código da vaga: 56292


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência com Angular, Nextjs, React, Typescript e Javascript.
  • Boas práticas de desenvolvimento, execução de testes end to end.
  • Diferencial se tiver conhecimentos/experiência com AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Proprietário do produto
description:
DESCRIÇÃO 

Como Product Owner, você será responsável por conduzir processos de descoberta, ideação e validação das funcionalidades do produto, transformando necessidades em soluções claras e priorizadas. Atuará diretamente com o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a evolução contínua do produto, alinhamento com stakeholders e entrega de valor aos usuários.

  • Escrever os requisitos de desenvolvimento e definir seus critérios de aceitação junto com o time; 
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento na execução e entrega das demandas, sempre buscando o alinhamento com o negócio e o produto; 
  • Participar de demonstrações do produto;  
  • Validar sistemas e soluções entregues pelo time desenvolvimento; 
  • Atuar junto com o líder técnico, identificando possíveis atrasos nas entregas e definindo mudanças de prioridades; 
  • Manter-se em constante atualização com as melhores práticas do mercado, trazendo sugestões e novas soluções. 

REQUISITOS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos B2C; 
  • Experiência na escrita de requisitos de desenvolvimento de software; 
  • Experiência na gestão de backlog de desenvolvimento; 
  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de priorização do product backlog; 
  • Familiaridade com processos de discovery; 
  • Vivência em times de desenvolvimento ágil; 
  • Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento com desenvolvedores, usuários e partes interessadas; 
  • Background técnico na área de programação; 
  • Conhecimentos em Figma ou ferramentas similares; 


DIFERENCIAIS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para maquininhas de pagamento; 
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções comerciais para o varejo e/ou marketplace; 
  • Conhecimento básicos de UX e UI; 
  • Certificação Product Owner (PSPO ou CSP);

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Configure switches and wireless access points.

- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.

- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.

- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary.

Qualifications:

- Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.

- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.

- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.

- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que

oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres.


Descrição:


Gerenciar equipe e supervisionar a realização das atividades da área, elaborando relatórios de controle e monitoramento, prestando assistência aos parceiros comerciais, acompanhando auditorias externas, conduzindo a equipe nos processos de entrega e devolução de quiosques, realizando análise de viabilidade de captação de novos produtos e parceiros, bem como fortalecendo o relacionamento com os operadores, visando garantir a prestação de serviços de qualidade aos clientes.


Atribuições:

  • Promover avaliação periódica da equipe, através da análise dos relatórios de produtividade, prestando feedbacks semanais, a fim de acompanhar o desempenho, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e auxiliar no desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Prestar assistência aos parceiros Comerciais, coordenando o acompanhamento das faltas e/ou intercorrências de produtos, para monitoramento do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Acompanhar mensalmente a auditoria externa (Contrato Ambev), presencialmente, prestando informações e auxílio aos auditores, para cumprimento de cláusulas contratuais e conferência do mix obrigatório de produtos nos quiosques.
  • Efetuar fechamento de Auditoria (Contrato Ambev), após a auditoria realizar conferência dos arquivos referentes, a fim de enviar à Ambev e ao setor Financeiro para encerramento do processo e emissão das notas fiscais para pagamento.
  • Acompanhar auditoria diária dos quiosques, através da agenda de visitas dos consultores e reporte do Supervisor, para conferência do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de controle operacional mensal ou mediante demanda elencando todas as atividades e resultados do departamento, incluindo evidências fotográficas de status dos quiosques se necessário, enviando os dados para acompanhamento pela diretoria.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.
  • Realizar estudo de viabilidade de novos produtos e/ou parceiros, analisando juntamente com o departamento de atendimento ao cliente, visando trazer maiores resultados aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar relatórios sanitários, conforme reporte da equipe de sanitaristas, para monitoramento das atividades realizadas e do desempenho de cada quiosque.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com novos operadores, através de agendamento prévio, visando alinhamento de execução do plano de ação inicial operacional onde são dispostas as principais demandas e obrigatoriedades do operador.
  • Garantir cadastro de novos clientes efetuando o processo junto aos operadores via sistema Check List, para obter os dados necessários para firmar novos parceiros e ações.
  • Acompanhar equipe nas inaugurações e entrega de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com operadores e departamentos responsáveis, garantindo o preenchimento de relatórios e termos pertinentes, a fim de criar comunicação efetiva com o cliente e garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar junto à equipe nas devoluções de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com o operador e departamento de Manutenção, assegurando o preenchimento de checklist de vistoria e o termo de devolução de posse assinado, para documentar o estado do quiosque na data, bem como obter evidências para realizar cobrança de itens que não estiverem em conformidade.

  • Cadastrar amarração de contratos Ambev via sistema Totvs, para identificação dos clientes correspondentes para posterior fechamento de penalidades (auxiliando o departamento Jurídico), para garantir que o setor Financeiro efetue o fechamento contábil da referida empresa.

description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers


Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.


This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.


The Role


As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.


What You Will Do


  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience


If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

Mergulhamos fundo em pesquisa, conceituamos a solução para o problema e aplicamos Design em busca de um desenvolvimento sustentável, colaborativo e orgânico.


✏️ Sua função

Seu papel como Multidisciplinary Designer será somar na tradução daquilo que encontramos e validamos em pesquisa, conectados ao conceito central do projeto e integrados à estratégia do nosso cliente. Tudo isso alinhado ao nosso propósito de superar a nós mesmos em tudo o que fazemos.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras
  • Tenha uma visão ampla sem perder o foco nas operações do dia a dia
  • Seja comprometido e tenha vontade de crescer


Como Multidisciplinary Designer, esperamos que você:

  • Desenhe peças incríveis que deixem todo mundo orgulhoso
  • Seja hábil na criação de composições visualmente atraentes e cheias de significado
  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca
  • Saiba conduzir uma boa pesquisa, conectando referências e autoridades do tema
  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior

We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, media operations, DevOps) to design efficient and scalable solutions.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with AWS services, cloud deployment models, and cross-cloud integration.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, data processing, or workflow integration.
  • Proven experience in workflow migration (media workflows preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • AVID MAM (Avid Media Asset Management) experience is mandatory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with media workflows, broadcast systems, or video delivery platforms.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments.

title: Consultora de moda
description:
Sobre a Koisa Linda


Fundada em 1994, a Koisa Linda é uma das maiores referências em moda festa no estado do Rio de Janeiro. Há mais de 30 anos, vestimos noivas, debutantes, madrinhas, convidados e o público masculino, sempre com foco em experiência, organização e excelência no atendimento .


Estamos iniciando um novo ciclo de profissionalização e expansão da área comercial e buscamos Consultoras de Moda que queiram crescer junto com a empresa, dentro de um Plano de Carreira estruturado .



O que faz uma Consultora de Moda na Koisa Linda


Esta não é uma vaga genérica de vendas.

Você será responsável por conduzir o cliente em toda a jornada , desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato, seguindo processos claros.


No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Receber e acolher clientes (noivas, debutantes, madrinhas, convidados e público masculino) de forma elegante e profissional.
  • Fazer escuta ativa para entender evento, sonho, estilo, orçamento e necessidades.
  • Apresentar opções de looks (vestidos, ternos e combinações) de forma consultiva , explicando cortes, tecidos e caimento.
  • Organizar e acompanhar as provas : separar peças, montar cabides, apoiar a cliente no provador e garantir fluidez no atendimento.
  • Conduzir o fechamento da venda : apresentar valores, condições, explicar o contrato e alinhar datas.
  • Registrar clientes, atendimentos e contratos no sistema , mantendo as informações atualizadas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com prova, costura e despacho, garantindo que o combinado com o cliente seja cumprido.
  • Cuidar da organização da loja, vitrines e araras, preservando o padrão visual da marca.



Responsabilidades


  • Atender com excelência e acompanhamento personalizado.
  • Seguir o manual de vendas , processos internos e padrões da marca.
  • Organizar provas, pedidos, ajustes e devoluções dentro dos prazos.
  • Cumprir metas individuais e contribuir para a meta da unidade .
  • Garantir experiência premium em todas as etapas do atendimento.
  • Registrar informações e acompanhar contratos no sistema.



Requisitos


  • Comunicação clara, empatia e elegância.
  • Organização, disciplina e responsabilidade.
  • Perfil comercial e facilidade em trabalhar com metas.
  • Desejável experiência em moda festa, consultoria de imagem ou boutiques de moda.
  • Disponibilidade para rotina de loja (terça a sábado) e eventuais domingos de campanha.



O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo compatível com o mercado.
  • Comissão vinculada à meta individual.
  • Bônus da unidade (quando aplicável).
  • Treinamento inicial estruturado e treinamento contínuo em vendas e produtos.
  • Plano de Carreira com trilha clara :

    • Consultora Júnior
    • Consultora Pleno
    • Consultora Sênior
    • Supervisor
    • Gerente
    • Ambiente de trabalho organizado, com cultura em desenvolvimento e forte potencial de crescimento para quem entrega resultado e postura profissional.



    Locais de trabalho


    Estamos contratando para as unidades:


    • São Francisco – Niterói (RJ)
    • Barra da Tijuca – Downtown (RJ) – nova unidade


    A unidade de atuação será alinhada durante o processo seletivo, conforme necessidade da empresa e perfil da candidata.



    Tipo de vaga


    • Regime: Tempo integral
    • Modalidade: Presencial
    • Setor: Comércio varejista de artigos do vestuário e acessórios

title: Especialista de Modelagem Hidráulica Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel.

  • Experiência com projetos de saneamento.
  • Capacidade analítica, organização, proatividade e comunicação eficaz.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Diferenciais

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR's Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Gerente de Projetos SAP SR
description:
Gerente de Projetos SAP experiente e altamente motivado(a) para liderar e gerenciar projeto de implementação (carve-in), migração e melhoria contínua relacionada à versão SAP S/4 RISE 2021 Foundation em um dos nossos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderança e Gestão de Projetos:
  • Planejar, executar, monitorar e finalizar projetos SAP de ponta a ponta, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Definir o escopo do projeto, criar e gerenciar cronogramas, orçamentos e planos de recursos.
  • Liderar equipes multifuncionais (consultores funcionais, técnicos, stakeholders de negócio) de forma eficaz.
  • Conhecimento SAP:
  • Atuar como ponto focal e expert em gestão de projetos focados em soluções SAP (ex: S/4HANA, ECC, módulos específicos como FI/CO, SD, MM, etc.).
  • Garantir que as soluções SAP entregues atendam aos requisitos de negócio e padrões de qualidade.
  • Metodologias e Frameworks:
  • Aplicar e adaptar metodologias de projeto (ex: PMI/PMBOK, ITIL, ASAP, Activate para S/4HANA) conforme a natureza e complexidade do projeto.
  • Utilizar frameworks Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em projetos SAP quando apropriado, promovendo entregas iterativas e valor contínuo.
  • Gestão de Risco e Mudança:
  • Identificar, analisar e mitigar proativamente riscos e problemas do projeto.
  • Gerenciar o processo de Mudança Organizacional (Organizational Change Management - OCM) relacionado à adoção do novo sistema SAP.
  • Comunicação e Stakeholder Management:
  • Garantir a comunicação clara e regular do status do projeto para todos os stakeholders (executivos, usuários finais, equipe).
  • Gerenciar expectativas e construir relacionamentos sólidos com patrocinadores e clientes internos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Essenciais:

  • Experiência Profissional: Sólida experiência em gestão de projetos de TI, de preferência atuação em Projetos de Carve-in e/ou setor de Energia, com foco comprovado em projetos SAP (implementações full cycle, upgrades ou migrações).
  • Conhecimento SAP: Profundo entendimento dos princípios, arquitetura e processos de pelo menos um grande módulo ou solução SAP (ex: S/4HANA, ECC, módulos logísticos ou financeiros).
  • Certificação/Metodologias: Conhecimento e experiência comprovada na aplicação de PMBOK/PMI e/ou metodologias Ágeis (Scrum Master/Product Owner).
  • Habilidades: Excelente liderança, organização, resolução de problemas, negociação e comunicação interpessoal.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificação: Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional), CSM (Certified ScrumMaster), ou certificação SAP Activate/ASAP.
  • Educação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Administração ou área relacionada. Pós-graduação é um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Proficiência em Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação HÍBRIDA (3x) no Centro do RJ
