title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.


Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);
    Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

description:

Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (.NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.

Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).

Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.


Principais responsabilidades:

Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias, realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy, gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).


Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.


Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.G., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.G., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.G., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.G., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.G., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Analista de Recrutamento Júnior - Híbrido (Rio de Janeiro, Brasil)


Esta função exige um mínimo de três dias por semana de trabalho presencial em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro.


Interviews will be conducted in English


Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

Você será responsável por revisar proativamente os candidatos para determinar se eles atendem aos requisitos rigorosos e à experiência de trabalho para perfis farmacêuticos complexos, garantindo uma experiência premium, contínua e elevada para todos os candidatos e partes interessadas.


O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.


✅ O Que Você Precisa Trazer

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral que refletem um profissionalismo de natureza polida.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.


✨ O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um líder de mercado global em serviços de RH com reconhecimento da indústria.
  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.


As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.


Junior Recruitment Analyst - Hybrid (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)


This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.


Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature , process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.


What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.G., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Application Process Leadership: Lead candidates through the initial stages of the application process with a focus on speed, discretion, and quality.
  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.


✅ What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.


✨ What’s In It For You

  • Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities.
  • Join a company that offers a great work/life balance.
  • Join a company with proven processes and high-output technology to create efficiency.


Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until filled.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.

  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.

  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.

Education:

BASIC FUNCTIONS:

The purpose of this position is to provide pedagogical, administrative, and research training and support for a Research Fellow in the School or College through including, but not limited to (a) academic career development, (b) development of health services to underserved populations (c) cultural competence. The Neuropsychopharmacology Laboratory at Howard University is seeking a postdoctoral fellow with data science expertise, interested in health disparities research. his work will contribute to precision medicine approaches to brain health. There is opportunity for collaboration with computer engineering, geneticists, and clinician colleagues. The ideal candidate will identify new research questions associated with brain health and disease, as it relates to the unique circumstances of underserved populations. The postdoc will be involved in enhancing the direction of clinical translational research conducted in the laboratory and will be expected to distribute their work to the scientific community through presentations and print.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Develop predictive tools to characterize clinical phenotypes and explore analytics associated with genetics of addiction and neuropsychiatric disorders.
  • Utilize large databases and electronic medical records to investigate social determinants of health and ethnicity-driven moderations of risk alleles for neuropsychiatric and substance use disorders.
  • Conduct research to understand brain function and also develop computational frameworks to analyze brain imaging data and to correlate findings with incidence of risk alleles for addiction and psychiatric disease.
  • Coordinates and assure development of pertinent reports and their timely delivery.
  • Participates in grant writing, development of manuscripts and reports, and conduct of primary and secondary data analyses.
  • Participates in weekly and/or bi-weekly group meetings, and professional training with or without students.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
  • Scientific writing skills demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications.
  • Ability to acquire accurate, reproducible data.
  • Critical eye towards consistency, reproducibility, and the scientific method in general
  • Excellent project and time management skills
  • Strong interpersonal and mentoring skills
  • Advocate for safety and ethics in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated computing experience and knowledge, including software packages such as word processing, database applications, and spreadsheet.
  • Competence in both oral and written English and ability to articulate concisely and in a professional manner. Ability to maintain confidentiality of information.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented interdisciplinary healthcare environment.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Applicants should have received, by the activation date of the postdoctoral fellowship, a Ph.D. (or similar doctoral degree such as MD, Pharm.D., Sc.D., DrPH, etc.) in one of the following disciplines: Neuroscience or data science related field.

description:

Fully Remote Contract

description:

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

AUTHORITY: None

Chief Operating Officer (COO) Howard University Faculty Practice Plan
Position Summary

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) of the Howard University Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the strategic, financial, and administrative oversight of the physician enterprise. The COO ensures that all ambulatory and faculty practice operations function efficiently and are aligned with the mission of Howard University and its academic health enterprise.

The COO partners closely with the CEO/Executive Director of the FPP, clinical department chairs, practice administrators, hospital leadership, and the College of Medicine to drive performance, expand access, strengthen the patient experience, and support the clinical, educational, and research missions.

Key Responsibilities Operational Leadership of the Physician Enterprise
  • Provide executive oversight of all ambulatory clinics, faculty practices, and related clinical operations.
  • Lead day-to-day operational performance including patient flow, scheduling, clinic throughput, call center performance, and care coordination.
  • Ensure that clinical operations meet standards of safety, quality, service excellence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Implement consistent operational policies, workflows, and performance standards across departments and practice sites.

Strategic Planning & Growth

  • Develop and execute strategies to support practice expansion, new clinical programs, and service line growth.
  • Assess market and demographic trends to inform future planning and provider network development.
  • Partner with University and hospital leadership to align practice operations with broader academic and clinical priorities.
  • Support recruitment planning, provider onboarding, and optimization of clinical FTE utilization.

Provider Access, Productivity & Performance Optimization

  • Lead initiatives to improve provider productivity, panel management, template design, and clinical capacity utilization.
  • Partner with department chairs and practice leaders to set and monitor operational KPIs (e.G., access metrics, cycle time, provider productivity, patient satisfaction).
  • Support performance review processes, compensation model implementation, and incentive alignment.

Financial & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Collaborate with the CFO to manage operating budgets, financial forecasts, and profitability of service lines.
  • Provide operational leadership for revenue cycle functions (e.G., registration, scheduling, charge capture workflows, documentation optimization, denial reduction).
  • Work with central revenue cycle leaders to ensure clean claims, timely billing, and improved collections.
  • Evaluate and optimize payer mix, managed care leverage, and ambulatory financial performance.

Systems, Technology & Data Integration

  • Oversee optimization of the electronic health record (EHR) and other clinical information systems to support efficient workflows.
  • Ensure accurate, real-time dashboards and data analytics to drive decision-making.
  • Champion the use of technology, automation, and digital health solutions to improve access and patient engagement.

Regulatory, Compliance & Quality Oversight

  • Ensure operational compliance with CMS, Joint Commission, ambulatory accreditation standards, HIPAA, OSHA, and related federal and local regulations.
  • Partner with quality leaders to strengthen ambulatory quality and patient safety programs.
  • Lead operational readiness for audits, surveys, and accreditation activities.

Leadership, Culture & People Management

  • Build and develop high-performing administrative and operational teams.
  • Promote a culture of equity, accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership development to practice managers and administrative staff.
  • Strengthen physician–administrative partnerships across departments.

Collaboration with Academic & Hospital Partners

  • Work closely with the College of Medicine to align clinical operations with teaching and training needs.
  • Coordinate with Howard University Hospital leadership to ensure smooth inpatient–outpatient continuum of care.
  • Assist in integrating residents and students into clinic operations in compliance with accreditation requirements.
Qualifications Education
  • Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related field required.
  • Additional certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or ambulatory operations preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in an academic medical center, faculty practice plan, or large multispecialty physician group.
  • Strong experience in ambulatory operations, physician enterprise management, and performance improvement.
  • Demonstrated success improving access, financial performance, and operational efficiency across multiple clinical departments.
  • Experience in a mission-driven, culturally diverse, urban healthcare environment preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
  • Deep understanding of physician practice economics and healthcare reimbursement.
  • Demonstrated change management and project management capability.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and physician-relations skills.
  • Commitment to health equity, community engagement, and service to underserved populations.

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

Purpose of Job

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Howard University (HU) Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) has responsibility for the achievement of the strategic, operational, and financial goals of HU FPP. This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations and execution of the strategic vision for the HU FPP, including overseeing and directing organizational and physician alignment, operating and financial efficiency of clinical enterprises, practice management, revenue cycle services, expansion of referral sources, information technology and electronic health record management implementation, managed care contracting, and marketing and public relations.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well-positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Job Responsibilities

Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility for the operations of HU FPP, including all aspects of effective operational and financial management and reporting, managed care contracting, and operational and capital budgeting

Develop and implement key initiatives to improve deficiencies ascertained through the evaluation of operations

Collaborate with Physician Enterprise leadership to apply effective processes, practice management tools, and best practices to the management of HU FPP

Evaluate the organizational structure for HU FPP, identifying the core competencies for each organizational unit, and effectively designing the relationships between organizational units to drive effective governance

Identify organizational goals, establish baseline metrics, development of key performance indicators, and standardize processes, and monitoring of performance against goals, including those related to patient satisfaction, physician engagement and satisfaction, employee engagement, patient access, clinical excellence and patient safety, efficiency and effectiveness and financial performance

Create and maintain a culture of accountability and serve as a resource for attaining performance metrics in all areas of the HU FPP

Evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with community-based organizations, payors, and other community stakeholders

Identify new opportunities in population health and with alternative payment models

Ability to work collaboratively with Chairs, Leadership and departmental Administrators, Physicians and Staff from diverse background and perspectives, across clinical and academic missions of an academic medical center to ensure efficient, effective clinic operations, while creating an environment conducive to engagement and satisfaction among physicians, other practitioners, and clinical staff

Knowledge:

* Knowledge of advanced primary care practice principles and Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) principles

The Chadwick A. Boseman College of Fine Arts at Howard University is excited to announce an opportunity for a visionary, collaborative, and accomplished leader to serve as Chair of the Department of Theatre Arts. The Chair serves as a mentor to faculty colleagues, collaborates with administrative leaders and staff members, and leads faculty in important processes that shape curriculum and inspire vision for theatre arts throughout the African Diaspora. The Chair strives to effectively articulate both the department and the College’s missions to internal and external constituencies and establishes an inclusive and welcoming academic environment that encourages engagement, participation, collegiality, and respect. The chair supervises all employees in the department and administers yearly performance evaluations, recommends faculty candidates for vacant positions, and makes recommendations regarding faculty reappointment, tenure, and promotion. The position is a 12-month appointment reporting to the Dean of the college. The Chair is expected to serve on elected and appointed committees and to accept other duties as assigned by the Dean.

With 44 full and part-time faculty, the Department of Theatre Arts serves over 150 students and offers BFA degrees in acting, dance, musical theatre, theatre arts administration, and theatre technology, and minors in theatre arts. Through research, experimentation, production, performance, and the education of emerging professionals, our faculty nurture holistic, multi-hyphenate, collaborative, interdisciplinary artists and scholars prepared to pioneer and lead their fields on the national and global stage. As the only College of Fine Arts in a historically Black, private university, our faculty are committed to educating leaders capable of employing the arts to drive change and solve world problems. The Department of Theatre Arts is dedicated to the continued growth and development of the African Diasporic experience through the study and practice of theatre and dance.

Leadership and Administrative Expectations
The Department Chair holds responsibilities invested in ensuring the success of the department’s faculty, staff, and students. This broad range of responsibilities includes (but is not limited to):
- Articulating a direction and goals for the department that align with college and university-level initiatives.
- Visioning and participating in cooperative collaboration efforts between CAB CoFA departments and across other colleges, schools, and programs at Howard University.
- Managing and optimizing department budget and resources (facilities, faculty, etc.).
- Developing partnerships with local, national, and international organizations, institutions, and industry stakeholders to enhance the department's and the college’s reputation and provide opportunities for students and faculty.
- Coordinating the activities of curriculum development and discipline-specific accreditation.
- Overseeing all faculty mentoring, service assignments, promotion and tenure reviews, work plans, workloads, hiring activities, and annual reviews.
- Managing day-to-day student affairs, including the planning of community-engaged activities and events.
- Collaborate with the recruitment and admissions team to support student recruitment, admission, and retention activities (e.G., new student orientation, department onboarding) and in consultation with the academic advisor.
- Coordinating interactions with alumni, donors, and visiting artists/scholars.
- Teaching in the Chair’s area of expertise will be expected, providing a forum for direct interaction with students in creative/academic contexts and affording opportunities to model scholarship within the department. It is expected that the Chair will have a 1/1 teaching load.
Qualifications
- MFA or PhD in one of the areas represented in the Department of Theatre Arts
- Knowledge of the higher educational landscape, research, and professional practices in performing arts.
- A minimum of five years of University-level teaching experience beyond the TA and/or adjunct level.
- Experience in academic administration or demonstrated leadership in institutional service or service to the field.
- A well-established research agenda with evidence of a significant performance record and/or scholarly record, external funding, and contributing to scholarship or creative practice that enhances and extends college/department expertise.
- Effective collaborative and communication skills are essential.
- The Chair will have demonstrated experience working in and fostering an environment of respect, professionalism, and civility with a population of faculty, staff, and students.
Consideration Process and Instructions .
The following documents should be submitted:
- Cover Letter that includes an overview of professional experience and creative research interests.
- Curriculum Vitae
- A philosophy statement addressing leadership, teaching, and approach to student Mentorship.
- List of five professional references, including names with titles and contact information. References will not be contacted prior to a candidate’s approval.

Salary Range: $145,000 - $150,000 with 30K Stipend for Chair role.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist

Company: Vytelle

Reporting to: IO Program Manager

Direct Reports: None

Location: Brazil

Salary Range: Contractor

Status: 1.0 FTE


ABOUT VYTELLE

We are a global precision livestock company reshaping how cattle producers worldwide unlock animal performance. Our portfolio includes world class Bovine phenotypic and genotypic data capture system via Vytelle SENSE and Vytelle INSIGHT which enables producers to accurately select desired traits to continually produce elite progeny, coupled with Vytelle ADVANCE In Vitro Fertilization Service, which enhances the speed at which genetic improvement can be made.


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a seasoned Quality Assurance Manager with a robust background in technology and software development. This role is designed for a dynamic professional who excels in leading quality assurance and control initiatives, ensuring the highest standards of quality in our cloud-based architecture solutions. With a pivotal role in our organization, the Quality Assurance Manager will be instrumental in driving our product excellence and customer satisfaction to new heights.


ROLE OVERVIEW

The Quality Assurance Specialist – SENSE Platform is a technically skilled professional with a software development background who is passionate about building quality into every layer of our product. This role is ideal for a developer who wants to broaden into quality engineering — combining hands-on coding, test automation, and problem-solving across SENSE’s three major components:

  1. Telemetry App: real-time, per-second data capture at customer sites.
  2. Data Processing Pipeline: cloud services that transform raw telemetry into daily phenotype values.
  3. Web UI Applications: dashboards, analytics, & animal trial management tools.

You will play a pivotal role in designing, automating, and executing tests that ensure data integrity, performance, and reliability across this full ecosystem — from device to dashboard.


FIRST 90 DAYS

  • Learn SENSE’s architecture, data flows, and operational objectives.
  • Review QA documentation, test scripts, and known defect logs to understand baseline coverage.
  • Build familiarity with the existing development and CI/CD environments (AWS, GitHub Actions, Playwright).
  • Begin authoring automated tests for one end-to-end SENSE workflow (Telemetry → Cloud → UI).
  • Partner with developers and the Product Assurance Manager to define acceptance criteria and test coverage for upcoming releases.
  • Identify quick-win improvements for testing efficiency and reporting visibility.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual tests for SENSE’s data-capture, processing, and visualization layers.
  • Conduct white-box tests (code-level, API, and service integration) and black-box tests (UI, end-user workflow, regression).
  • Collaborate with developers to integrate testing directly into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build and maintain test harnesses for RESTful APIs, data streams, and web services.
  • Write and review test scripts in Python, JavaScript, or C# to validate logic and data transformations.
  • Troubleshoot telemetry-to-cloud data discrepancies, working with developers to isolate root causes.
  • Contribute to the design of performance and reliability tests for high-frequency sensor data.
  • Participate in UAT and release readiness reviews, ensuring alignment with product requirements and field conditions.
  • Document test results, create bug reports, and verify fixes.
  • Continuously learn new QA tools, frameworks, and automation approaches.


SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

Education and Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical field.
  • 3–6 years of software development or test-automation experience.
  • Strong interest in transitioning toward or expanding within Quality Assurance.
  • Experience working with distributed or IoT-style systems is an asset.

Technical Skills:

  • Solid programming knowledge in Python, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with automation frameworks (e.G., Playwright, Selenium, PyTest, Postman/Newman)
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message-based architectures.
  • Understanding of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) data stores.
  • Exposure to AWS environments (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS) is a plus.
  • Comfortable working in Linux and Windows environments.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Preferred: experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and telemetry data pipelines.

Soft Skills:

  • Analytical and curious mindset — enjoys tracing a defect through multiple code layers.
  • Strong communication skills across remote, multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, iterative environment.
  • Collaborative attitude and willingness to learn new domains (ag-tech, IoT, data science).
  • Because this role supports global teams and requires regular communication with colleagues and customers in English-speaking regions, proficiency in English (verbal and written) is required. Candidates must be able to read, write, and speak English fluently to perform the essential functions of the position.


SUCCESS METRICS

  • Increased automation coverage across all SENSE components.
  • Faster regression cycles and fewer escaped defects in production.
  • Reduced test execution time through CI/CD integration.
  • Verified data accuracy between telemetry capture and phenotype calculation.

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

Job description

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Local de Atuação: Miguel Pereira, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar o acompanhamento jurídico e contratual da concessão, incluindo o diagnóstico da realidade operacional frente às condições previstas no edital e contrato, a análise de passivos adquiridos e a gestão de eventuais contingências (concorrência/licitação), identificando divergências e propondo soluções;
  • Prestar assessoria jurídica às áreas internas em matérias contratuais e regulatórias, articulando-se com escritórios externos e demais gestores;
  • Atuar ativamente em reuniões com clientes internos e externos, órgãos públicos e agências reguladoras, oferecendo suporte jurídico e orientação legal para assegurar a conformidade das práticas operacionais com o Contrato de Concessão e a legislação vigente;
  • Atuar na área consultiva, prestando suporte jurídico estratégico às áreas internas com foco na interpretação e aplicação do Contrato de Concessão;
  • Apoiar e acompanhar pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro, elaborando peças jurídicas e revisando peças técnicas de suporte à defesa dos interesses da Concessionária;
  • Atuação na Revisão Ordinária do Contrato de Concessão;
  • Elaborar respostas a ofícios e manifestações da Agência Reguladoras, do Poder Concedente e demais stakeholders institucionais;
  • Gerir, administrar e prestar contas da documentação legal e regulatória da concessão, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais perante as Agências Reguladoras, o Poder Concedente e outros órgãos de controle;
  • Monitorar metase obrigações contratuais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e indicadores previstos no contrato e em normativos regulatórios;
  • Acompanhar novos regulamentos, legislações e interpretações normativas, atualizando procedimentos internos e promovendo o alinhamento institucional às diretrizes da AGENERSA, ANA e demais entidades setoriais (como a ABCON-RJ);
  • Prestar suporteem auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a adequada organização, arquivamento e rastreabilidade da documentação jurídica e contratual.
Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito,
  • Inscrição ativa na OAB;
  • Domínio no pacote Office, em especial no Power Point;
  • Experiência comdireito administrativo e regulatório;

  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário de Inglês.

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile).
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Day‑off de aniversário.
  • TotalPass.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement

  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About youExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership
